title: ResourceMonitorService
responsibility: Refreshes telemetry, heartbeats running work and waits for admission while checking cancellation and parent lifetime.

inputs.name: ResourceMonitorService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Optional telemetry dependencies, cancellation, queue timeout or waiting callback for the named operation.

inputs.name: ResourceMonitorService.heartbeat.id
inputs.description: Lease UUID whose job or heartbeat is read or updated.

inputs.name: ResourceMonitorService.wait.id
inputs.description: Lease UUID whose job or heartbeat is read or updated.

inputs.name: ResourceMonitorService.wait.request
inputs.description: Requested priority, CPU cores, memory in MiB and public label to validate against available capacity.

inputs.name: ResourceMonitorService.wait.options
inputs.description: Optional telemetry dependencies, cancellation, queue timeout or waiting callback for the named operation.

outputs.name: ResourceMonitorService.snapshot
outputs.description: Latest timestamped host observation, absent before the first sample.

outputs.name: ResourceMonitorService.heartbeat
outputs.description: Refreshes the running lease and pressure notice without interrupting its work.

outputs.name: ResourceMonitorService.sweep
outputs.description: Removes only stale leases with owners and tracked workers proven absent.

outputs.name: ResourceMonitorService.wait
outputs.description: Resolves after admission; cancellation, expiry and invalid parent state reject.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Cancelled, expired, impossible, disappeared or orphaned queued reservations reject before executing work.
